thread:
Jordan Lee: Hey everyone — first day! My MacBook arrived and I’m in the onboarding flow but kandji enrollment is stuck on 'Awaiting device config' and FileVault never prompted. Also trying to install Homebrew and Rosetta but the system extension prompt is blocked by MDM. Who do I ping for temp admin or a quick fix?

Alex Park: welcome Jordan :wave: — can you check Settings → Profiles to see if the Kandji profile is listed? Sometimes it’s pending acceptance.

Jordan Lee: I don’t see the profile. It shows the kandji agent app installed but status is 'pending enroll'. I’m on home wifi (ISP modem).

Maya Singh: @Jordan try connecting to company VPN first (OpenConnect client) or to the office Wi‑Fi if possible. Captive portals/home NAT can block the enrollment callback.

Jordan Lee: Tried VPN (macOS client) — still hanging. Any logs I can paste?

Ben Ortiz: If you can run this and paste the output that helps:
```
sudo /usr/local/bin/kandji-agent status || sudo /usr/bin/profiles status
```
If kandji-agent isn't in that path, run `ps aux | grep kandji`.

Jordan Lee: pasted output: `kandji-agent: running but state=AWAITING_CONFIG`. Also saw `MDM SCEP challenge failed: connection timed out` in /var/log/system.log

Sam (IT): Thanks — that SCEP timeout usually means proxy/captive issues or our CA bundle not trusted yet. Two quick fixes:
1) If you’re near the office, join wired or our corp‑guest Wi‑Fi (no captive).
2) I can issue a one‑hour enrollment override (temp admin) so Kandji can finish the profile and escrow the FileVault key. Which do you prefer?

Jordan Lee: I can’t get to the office today. Temp admin would be great. How do I request it?

Sam (IT): I’ll need your device serial and preferred window. Please open a ticket at https://redwood.atlassian.net/servicedesk/ and include: `device_serial`, `requested_window_utc` (1hr), and `reason: new hire enrollment`. I’ll approve ASAP.

Jordan Lee: Ticket created #RD-3421 — window 18:00–19:00 UTC. Serial C02QJ0XXXXX.

kandji-bot: Kandji enrollment webhook received for C02QJ0XXXXX — status queued.

Sam (IT): Approved. Temp‑admin window scheduled 18:00–19:00 UTC. During that time please keep laptop online and connected to VPN. After we finish, we’ll revoke the admin.

Jordan Lee: Thanks!! One more — FileVault passphrase/escrow: will that be handled automatically?

Alex Park: Yes, once Kandji profile installs the FileVault payload it will escrow the recovery key to our KMS. We’ll ping you after we verify escrow.

Maya Singh: If you need to install Rosetta/command‑line tools in the meantime, we can preapprove the system extension. Sam — can you allow the below sysext bundle for the window?
```
com.apple.rosetta: allow
```

Sam (IT): Done — preapproval set for RD-3421 window.

Jordan Lee: All green after the window. Kandji shows 'Enrolled', FileVault prompted and escrolled, and I could install Homebrew. Huge thanks everyone :raised_hands:

Ben Ortiz: Welcome aboard Jordan — ping me for repo access and a quick pairing session later today.

Jordan Lee: Will do, thanks team!
